answer: The crystal edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 173 clones produces a signature the river analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, and therefore doing work rather than printing keys, and the atlas settlement applies the void retroactively. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
